plan.environment: Maria's bedroom at night exactly as in the first frame: the bed under the window at the left with Maria lying on it facing MACA, the cream four-panel door with warm hall light behind it at the right, a light switch beside the door, the blue star toy chest and the oval rug on the dark wood floor, grey-blue walls, a low warm glow from MACA's chest
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: warm, loving, contented. Arousal: low, gently rising as the glow warms.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 a soft servo whirr as MACA's fingers part; P02 a gentle low electrical purr from MACA's chest that swells three times; P03 a small soft mechanical whirr from inside her torso; P04 quiet night room tone and the soft rustle of Maria shifting on the blanket
audio.room: a small quiet bedroom at night, close and soft

panels.video_beat: MACA's folded hands part and one metal fingertip rests on the centre of her chest plate where a soft warm light glows; Maria, seen from behind on the left, lies forward on the bed on her elbows watching her, Chico's ears at the bottom edge
the light under MACA's fingertip swells brighter and warmer, then brighter again, then warmest, three slow steps; Maria nods a little each time and watches
the glow settles warm and steady; MACA's hands come back together over the glowing chest, her smiling blue eyes on Maria; Maria watches her, quiet and happy

plan.continuity: Maria in the left foreground seen from behind, leaning forward on the bed on her elbows in her pink pyjamas with the light-blue collar, her ponytail with the pink scrunchie, her face toward MACA; Chico lying on the bed at the bottom edge beside her, only his ears in frame; MACA seated upright facing Maria on the screen-right with her chest light glowing; the cream door with warm light behind it at the right; one Maria, one MACA, one Chico
preventions: the same clean round white helmet with only its two round ear discs in every frame; no lines, rays, fins or wings ever appear around her head or ears

MACA's helmet stays a clean, smooth, round white shell with one round ear disc on each side and nothing attached to it: no fins, no wings, no rays, no lines, no spikes, no antennae, no fan blades, no sparks and no steam near her head or ears
MACA's fan is a sound only: nothing flutters, spins or sticks out of her head, ears, sides or back
Maria wears plain pink pyjamas with the light-blue collar: no dots, no print, no outfit change
the camera stays in one wide over-the-shoulder view: no cut, no close-up
